primary.target: At least 29 of 32 filtered graphs are exact.
primary.scope: Exact preregistered finite-bank target. No independent-edge or population-confidence claim.

theorem_scope: Supplied digit-balance prior: no completed board has more than 9 copies of a digit. Every 25-query collapse is rejected; every clean subset is accepted. This restores clean pair evidence but does not guarantee enough samples for exact recovery or fix scalar noise calibration.
limitations: Explicitly supplied global digit-balance prior; not a graph-free learned guarantee in arbitrary tasks.
Filtering is specific to detectable shared collapse; other correlated noise can evade it.
Perfect filtering does not guarantee exact support with fewer accepted samples.
No solver accuracy or certification experiment. BP AdamW outside this source-only study; not run.

runtime.accounting: Process user+system CPU for this orchestrator and all reaped children; active child CPU polled from /proc. OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL threads fixed to1.
